subject: Post-demo follow-up — aligning on VPC / Dedicated deployment path
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Turner <alyssa.turner@harborfin.com>, Devon Brooks <devon.brooks@harborfin.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo follow-up & suggested path for VPC / Dedicated option

Hi Alyssa / Devon,

Thanks again for the time today — appreciate you walking through your scoring/transaction flow and the regulatory constraints around data residency. Quick recap and suggested next steps from our side: 

What we covered
- Demo: inference latency targets under realistic workload, prefix caching behavior, and failover rules.
- VPC / Dedicated: how a VPC private deployment gives you network isolation and a Dedicated pool handles predictable throughput.
- Questions raised: SOC2 evidence, audit logging retention, and procurement timelines.

Suggested next steps
1) Security deep-dive (30–45m) with our Product Security + Solutions Engineering — cover SOC2, KMS/HSM options, audit logs, and on-prem packaging.
2) Draft MLP: propose a 6–8 week POC on Dedicated capacity (small reserved pool) to validate perf and integration.
3) Procurement prep: I attached a draft pricing sheet and a simple VPC architecture sketch for your infra team to review.

Attachments: redwood-dedicated-pricing.pdf (pdf), vpc-architecture-sketch.png (image)

A couple quick asks so we can prioritize:
- Can you confirm whether procurement is targeting a Q3 decision window, or is this shifting to Q4?
- Who on your infra/security side should we loop into the deep-dive?

If it helps, I can propose two time slots for the security call next week. Would you prefer morning PST or early afternoon?

Thanks,
Karthik
--

Karthik —

Thanks for the summary and the artifacts. Quick answers:
- Procurement is still working our internal capex calendar; initial guidance is leaning toward pushing large infrastructure commitments to Q4.
- Security questions: our InfoSec team will need SOC2 artifact access, an explanation of KMS integration, and clarifications on log retention for audit purposes.

We remain interested in proving this out, but I need to align with procurement/stakeholders on whether we can run a small reserved pilot in Q3 or must wait. Can your security folks provide sample SOC2 evidence and an architecture slide that highlights data flows and custody for the pilot?

Also, please hold off on any formal contract step until I confirm with procurement. I'll circle back early next week with a clearer timeline.

—Alyssa

On Tue, Jul 28, 2026 at 10:08 AM Alyssa Turner <alyssa.turner@harborfin.com> wrote:
> Karthik —
> 
> Thanks for the summary and the artifacts. Quick answers:
> - Procurement is still working our internal capex calendar; initial guidance is leaning toward pushing large infrastructure commitments to Q4.
> - Security questions: our InfoSec team will need SOC2 artifact access, an explanation of KMS integration, and clarifications on log retention for audit purposes.

Appreciate the context, Alyssa — and understood on procurement timing. A couple options to keep momentum without requiring a full Q3 capex commitment: 

- Option A — Technical pilot on Hosted with dedicated networking (short-lived): 4 weeks of focused testing using hosted capacity + network peering; includes priority support and an SLA-backed test window.
- Option B — Small Dedicated POC (reserved small pool) for 6 weeks — requires a limited commitment but demonstrates real throughput and prefix cache behavior.

What we can do right away:
- Share SOC2 summary and a redacted artifact for your InfoSec (we can request exec summary + auditor contact under NDA).
- Schedule product security session next week — I can coordinate folks from our Security and Solutions Eng teams.
- Provide a revised, conservative quote for the Dedicated POC (lower initial commit + pilot terms).

If procurement is leaning to Q4, we can still run the security deep-dive now so your team has answers on the backlog. Would you be available for a 30–45m session on one of these slots?
- Wed Aug 11, 10:00–11:00am ET
- Thu Aug 12, 1:00–2:00pm ET

I should note: we can also extend a Hosted trial credit while you align procurement if that helps justify an earlier technical run.

Thanks — any preference on the slots? If you want, I can also loop in our Solutions Engineer to draft a redlined pilot scope for procurement to review.

Best,
Karthik
--

Thanks, Karthik —

Sorry for the short reply. Procurement has indicated they will likely want to push major commitments to Q4, but the technical team is keen to do the security deep-dive so they can start capturing requirements. Wed Aug 11 at 10am ET works for us.

Two asks before the session:
1) Can you send the SOC2 executive summary and a short note on log retention (retention windows and exportability)?
2) Please provide a revised pilot quote that assumes a small Dedicated pool (minimal commit) and includes one-time onboarding assistance; procurement will want that in the packet though they may not sign until Q4.

I attached our procurement questionnaire (procurement-questionnaire.pdf) to help shape the quote.

I’ll bring our InfoSec lead and Devon to the call. If you can loop in Solutions Eng + Security, that’ll be perfect.

—Alyssa
